exceptions.reason: Text drawn inside an SVG illustration: the self-host diagram and the MacBook's macOS menu bar. It is sized in viewBox units and axe cannot measure its background. Pixel sampling measured the diagram labels at 5.1:1 or more.
Gradient-filled headings (background-clip: text), which axe cannot measure. Pixel sampling measured the lightest end of the gradient at 4.1:1 or more; these are large text, which needs 3:1.
Buttons in the closing call to action sit on translucent surfaces over the decorative grid and glow layers, which axe cannot see through. Pixel sampling measured 5.4:1 or more.
Titles, artists and paths in the demos truncate to one line with an ellipsis on purpose, as in the app's track lists.
